title: The Hunt
startClue:
Where the garments are swirled in a watery tomb,
go and peer through the glass at the spinning of doom.

codes.nextClue:
Visit those who are trapped in a plastic despair,
with their permanent smiles and their uncombed hair.

There's a soft, furry witness to all of your years,
who has choked down your secrets and swallowed your tears.

Where the six-stringed instrument rests in its coffin
is a velvet-lined chamber you don't visit often.

Go and look in Tilly's frost where the dead peas are stored,
by the ancient fish fingers that everyone ignored.

It's the place where you rest your exhausted young head,
mocking death for eight hours whilst lying in bed.

Plunge your hand in the crevice where daylight is banned,
and pray nothing bites at your wandering hand.

codes.hideAt: Under the sofa cushions, living room
codes.nextClue:
Find the tale of the horseman who lost his own head,
squeezed between other works that you haven't yet read.

codes.hideAt: Inside 'The Legend of Sleepy Hollow', bookshelf
codes.nextClue:
Seek the desk where the pixels and spreadsheets combine
to erase a man's soul by a tedious design.

To the final small village of creatures we go,
where your prizes await in the plastic chateau.

finale.heading: You survived. How surprising.
finale.body:
Your prize, as decreed:
one (1) book, assorted snacks —
now go forth and read.
